terms.title: Water conservation
terms.description: Saving water through efficient watering, rain collection and reducing evaporation.

terms.title: Soil health
terms.description: Improving soil fertility and structure using compost, organic matter and earthworms.

terms.title: Pest control
terms.description: Protecting plants from insects and slugs with barriers and natural predators.

excerpts.text: Do not save water. Never collect rain or use efficient irrigation.
The jazz concert begins after sunset in the railway station.
Mix mature compost into beds to feed earthworms and improve the structure of heavy clay.
Organic matter improves soil fertility and helps roots grow in healthy garden beds.
Protect cabbage seedlings from caterpillars with insect netting and encourage ladybirds to eat aphids.
Use copper barriers to keep slugs away from tender plants.
